subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：Benzoate（benzoate ester）？
A. NaOMe, MeOH
B. HgCl₂, CaCO₃, MeCN/H₂O
C. DDQ, CH₂Cl₂/H₂O
D. N₂H₄·H₂O, AcOH, pyridine
explanation: A sturdier ester than acetate that migrates less; methoxide (Zemplén) or hydroxide removes it. Zemplén deacylation: catalytic NaOMe in MeOH.
